question: What was total net revenue in 2025-Q3?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT SUM(net) AS value FROM lines WHERE order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date < '2025-10-01'

question: Show net revenue by department for 2025.

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT d.category_name AS department, SUM(l.net) AS net_revenue FROM lines l JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories d ON d.category_id = cat.parent_category_id WHERE l.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND l.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.category_name

question: What was our gross margin last quarter?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), cost_lines AS ( SELECT l.*, l.net_units * pc.unit_cost AS cogs FROM lines l JOIN product_costs pc ON pc.product_id = l.product_id AND pc.effective_from <= l.order_date AND (pc.effective_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < pc.effective_to)) SELECT (SUM(net) - SUM(cogs)) * 1.0 / SUM(net) AS value FROM cost_lines WHERE order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Which product categories experienced the largest revenue decline last quarter?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), q AS (SELECT cat.category_name AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND l.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN l.net ELSE 0 END) AS q4, SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND l.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN l.net ELSE 0 END) AS q3 FROM lines l JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_name) SELECT category, q4 - q3 AS revenue_change FROM q WHERE q4 - q3 < 0 ORDER BY q4 - q3 ASC

notes: Categories whose net revenue declined Q4 vs Q3 2025 (QoQ), largest absolute decline first. Categories that grew are not part of the answer.

question: What were the top 5 products by net revenue in 2025?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT l.product_id, SUM(l.net) AS net_revenue FROM lines l WHERE l.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND l.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY l.product_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which regions generated the highest profit growth last quarter?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), cost_lines AS ( SELECT l.*, l.net_units * pc.unit_cost AS cogs FROM lines l JOIN product_costs pc ON pc.product_id = l.product_id AND pc.effective_from <= l.order_date AND (pc.effective_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < pc.effective_to)), g AS (SELECT COALESCE(rg.region_name, 'Unassigned') AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.order_date >= '2025-10-01' THEN cl.net - cl.cogs ELSE 0 END) AS p4, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND cl.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN cl.net - cl.cogs ELSE 0 END) AS p3 FROM cost_lines cl LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cl.ship_region_id WHERE cl.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND cl.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY COALESCE(rg.region_name, 'Unassigned')) SELECT region, (p4 - p3) * 1.0 / p3 AS profit_growth FROM g WHERE region <> 'Unassigned' ORDER BY profit_growth DESC LIMIT 3

notes: Gross profit QoQ growth rate, Q4 vs Q3 2025; Unassigned excluded from ranking.

question: Which acquisition channel brought in the most new customers in 2025?

gold.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM f JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id WHERE f.first_date >= '2025-01-01' AND f.first_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel ORDER BY new_customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show monthly net revenue for the Laptops category in 2025.

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT cal.month, SUM(l.net) AS net_revenue FROM lines l JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date_key = l.order_date WHERE cat.category_name = 'Laptops' AND cal.year = 2025 GROUP BY cal.month

question: What was the monthly customer retention rate for each month from February to December 2025?

gold.sql: WITH active AS ( SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id, cal.year, cal.month, c.segment, c.home_region_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date_key = o.order_date WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT cur.month, COUNT(nxt.customer_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS retention FROM active cur LEFT JOIN active nxt ON nxt.customer_id = cur.customer_id AND nxt.year = 2025 AND nxt.month = cur.month + 1 WHERE cur.year = 2025 AND cur.month BETWEEN 1 AND 11 GROUP BY cur.month

notes: Gold rows are keyed by the prior month M-1; key_transform maps them to the retention month M.

question: Identify the customers with declining purchase frequency.

gold.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w1, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w2 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT customer_id FROM w WHERE w1 >= 3 AND w2 <= 0.5 * w1

question: Why did Outdoor Gear revenue in the West region drop in Q3 2025?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND l.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN l.net END) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND l.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN l.net END) AS value FROM lines l JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = l.ship_region_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Outdoor Gear' AND rg.region_name = 'West'
